lastTask: Merge approved Track D5 autonomous evolving performance

projectState.summary: Track D5 is approved by Claude and merged locally to main. Evolution supports a bounded 500-generation cap plus startGenerationIndex for timer-batched runs. The default-off window.prosody.performEvolvingElite() driver evolves phrase candidates in batches, auditions the current best through the existing D2 melody override, and swaps only to strictly higher-fitness elites; stopEvolvingElite() cancels the timer and clears the audition override. Claude live-verified heard fitness improving 0.7945 -> 0.8199 -> 0.859 over 50 generations, final melody in-scale, and clean stop. Carry forward: frequent future swaps may need a softer re-anchor strategy, and shared client/server helper modules remain open.
